name: Albert Macdgul
original_name: アルバート・マクドガル
source: A reporter that came to Desire to investigate the research being conducted, and to investigate rumors about Professor Stella. He's the first reporter that has been allowed on the island. Sometimes he goes by Al, and he is excited to see his girlfriend Makoto, whom works on the island, after a month away from her.
